description_en: A water tank from approximately 14th-15th century. The water tank (nāuloin Doteli language) is located a a few hundred meters to the north of the temple complex of Devala Hāṭa (BTD0030). Devala Hāṭa is a settlement located between Dehīmāṇḍau in the south-east and Goṭhalāpānī in the north-west. Another name for the locality is Gaḍī.The monument borrows a spatial organisation similar to that of the Dullu water tank erected by the minister Devavarmā in 1354, during the rule of the Khaśa Malla emperor Pṛthvī Malla and the water tanks visible in Ajayamerukot. The latter were most probably built during the second half of the 14th century. The monument originally had two side pavilions flanking the arched access to water. Only one remain, in the west. As rightfully noted by D. R. Sharma, the arched entrance is a novelty unseen on the Ajayamerukot and Dullu reservoirs (Sharma 2012: 344). The opening of the tank, with the arch, is oriented to the south. The reservoir is covered by a finely carved corbelled dome.It is also locally known as Śiv nāulo (Śiva nāulo), which is in line with the largely Shaiva nature of the monuments and arts found in Devala Hāṭa.Given the historical context of the place, with the nearbyśikharatemples (BTD0030) dating from approx. 14th-15th century, it is most likely that this monument is contemporaneous to the construction of the temples. Thus, in this perspective the monument would have been erected during the reign of a king of Doti, such as Nirai Pāla (r. c. 1362-1383) or Nāga Malla (also Nāga Pāla, r. c. 1383-1411) (about the Doteli kings seePandey 1997: 171-173 andOjha 1988).The dimensions of the remaining structure are: 545 x 424 x 200 cm.The reservoir itself has the following dimensions: 350 x 318 x 200 cm.
description_ne: यो प्राचीन पानी ट्याङ्की देवल हाट मन्दिर परिसरबाट (BTD0030) केही सय मिटरको दूरीमा छ । यो पानी ट्याङ्कीको संरचनागत विशेषता ईशाको साढे चौधौं शताब्दीतिर बनाइएका अजयमेरुकोटका ट्याङ्कीहरू र दुल्लुमा खश मल्ल राजा पृथ्वी मल्लको शासनकालका मन्त्री देव वर्माले सन् १३५४ मा बनाएको पानी ट्याङ्कीसंग मिल्दछ । यो पानी ट्याङ्कीलाई स्थानीयहरू शिव नाउलो भन्दछन् । यो पानी ट्याङ्की नजिकै भएका शिखर मन्दिरहरू (BTD0030) ईशाको चौधौं या पन्ध्रौं शताब्दीका हुन सक्ने अनुमान गर्न सकिन्छ र यसैका आधारमा यो सम्पदा पनि यीनै मन्दिरहरू बनाइएको समय आसपासमा नै बनाइएको हुने सम्भावना बलियो छ । यस आधारमा भन्दा यी सम्पदाहरू डोटीका राजा निरै पाल (अनुमानित शासनकाल सन् १३६२-१३८३) वा नाग पाल (अनुमानित शासनकाल सन् १३८३-१४११) का शासनकालमा निर्माण गरिएका हुन् । डोटीका राजाहरूका बारेमा थप तथ्यहरूपाण्डे(1997: 171-173) रओझा(1988) मा हेर्न सकिन्छ ।अहिले देख्न सकिने संपूर्ण संरचनाको नाप ५४५ x ४२४ x २०० सेन्टीमिटर छ र ट्याङ्कीको मात्रै नाप ३५० x ३१८ x २०० सेन्टीमिटर छ ।
